title: Critical tribes size power limit
statement: For each natural number $w$, let $s_w$ be the greatest natural number at most $2^{w+2}$ such that $1-(1-2^{-w})^{s_w}\le 1/2$. As $w$ tends to infinity, $(1-2^{-w})^{\max(s_w-1,0)}$ tends to $1/2$.
